question: What disposition should ClawHub staff apply to the @ifabrish-skills / @ifabrish namespace claim?
rationale: The code can support reservation actions, but claimant authority, production registry state, sensitive evidence handling, and final namespace disposition are trust-and-safety decisions.

options.title: Request clearer proof first
options.body: Ask the claimant for exact ClawHub URLs and public-safe evidence before any registry mutation.

options.title: Reserve after verification
options.body: If staff independently verifies authority and registry state, apply the audited reservation or transfer using existing admin tooling.

options.title: Decline the claim
options.body: If proof remains insufficient or the namespace should remain unchanged, close with the reason and safe self-serve guidance.

recommendation.title: Request clearer proof first
recommendation.body: Ask the claimant for exact ClawHub URLs and public-safe evidence before any registry mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current namespace-claim docs/RFC history and is named on CODEOWNERS for the relevant security-sensitive surfaces.
